title: External tensor sections with affine second factor
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Assume $X$ is quasi-compact, the diagonal of $f$ is affine, and $Y$ is affine. For quasi-coherent module sheaves $F,G$ [pqf-def-coherent], the explicit external tensor map [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison] $\Gamma(X,F)\otimes_k\Gamma(Y,G)\to\Gamma(X\times_kY,\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G)$ is bijective.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, equation-kunneth-on-cech; degree-zero finite-cover argument

proof.text: Choose the finite subcover of the affine open cover of X. Its chart opens are affine; the affine-diagonal criterion for f makes every pairwise intersection affine. On any such affine open V, the restriction of F is quasi-coherent by the Mathlib restriction instance, and V and Y are both affine. Apply the affine-by-affine comparison to their external sections.

Apply finite-cover descent in the first factor to the cover opens and the chart and overlap bijectivity just obtained. The subcover covers top, so the resulting global comparison is bijective. Empty charts and overlaps are allowed by the affine comparison and descent statements.
